name: smh_rp8s_f

pin_regs.reason: every data pin is registered in RTL: inputs rin (ot_rp4l_pinrow), bin (pinbeat), xs straps (5-stage strap), gin (u_gn u_v/u_d), xi_* (u_lands / u_xgi / u_xpi); outputs rout launched by the r6 glue pin register u_ro, bout by u_be2, xo_* by u_xbo / u_xgo / u_xpo, gout by the u_gs output registers.  Recipe-3 pin registers would add cycles to the priced lp schedule.  rp4a: the static attn strap lands in 2 kept stages (u_as_n / u_as_s).

job.purpose: r8 landing-local placement boxes at the landings (r7 MAIN RTL, 0 cycles)
job.structural_change: r8 (H.STA.BLK.14.6): r7 MAIN RTL unchanged (0 edges); FALLBACK soft landing local: one placement box per landing half (and per endpoint child) at its landing; locals free inside it. Read halves sit beside the hard-child / port pins their o bits feed (bit-exact pins from the child LEFs), rings beside the pins their i bits come from, soft-ended halves follow their same-region chain (tools/hbm_smh_r8/landing_boxes.py, results/arch/hbm_smh_r8_1022/landing_boxes_smh_rp8s_f.json). Fixes the r7 class: xs band had no room at the x-store bk1 (north) face, m band none at the merge top face, so GPL spread single locals across the band (u_lpl_9_r chunk82 -781.8 ps, u_lpl_27_r chunk13 -620, u_lpl_22_w -417 at CTS).

reset_landing.reason: the lp RTL lands rst_n (pin stage u_lpr_pin on its face band, regional run rooted in c, same-depth reset forest, depth 3 + 1) and ot_rp5_rst kept copies per consumer; priced in the landed record

safe_design_checklist.1_pins: Existing registered faces kept; face stages now use their own landed root. Original hard-child pin registers unchanged.
safe_design_checklist.2_reach: Every landing half boxed at its landing: read halves beside the pins they feed, rings beside their source pins; ring->read centre distance <= 723 um Manhattan (E=2 window, 2 x 405 um planned reach), 4 manual mid anchors (0r/1r/41w/42w east middle, 4r west middle, 44r) keep two-crossing chains inside it. A local's select->o path never leaves its box.
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: Kept W24 landing reset field copies and same-edge per-consumer reset copies. Native census must pass before layout; no waiver.
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: No arithmetic logic added; all schedule compensation is registered. Original hard children unchanged.
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: Landings are D4 rings. Additional delay compensation is a fixed-throughput chain of three-slot rings in kept eight-bit chunks; no indexed wide flop store or long shift pipeline. Same 3/6/9/12 data-edge ages; phase reset copies are bounded.
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: Unchanged 691.2x1252.8 pin-bound outline, hard children, 43.2 lattice and r7 bands; landing boxes (util 0.33 est., grown in-hook above 0.45) never overlap a hard child + 5.4 halo or each other; dissolved before DPL with the r7 bands.
safe_design_checklist.7_clock: 9 landed regional roots; face pins separated from hard-child insertion, x-store on own root; child centring taps; TT/FF within-region spread <=80 remains required. Hold margins 0.03.
safe_design_checklist.8_schedule: Static retiming against r6, interface output offsets {'rout_s': 6, 'gout': 12}; regional reset depth 4. Edge equality recorded for every source/read pair; exact miter and priced composition required.
